source_doc.title: POET Technologies to Supply Celestial AI with its Optical Interposer-based Integrated Light Engine Modules (POET SEC Form 6-K Exhibit 99.1, Feb 10, 2022)
source_doc.permission_basis: Official SEC EDGAR primary filing (POET Technologies Form 6-K, Exhibit 99.1), public domain government-hosted disclosure. Repository retains attributed extraction and canonical SEC URL.

sources.quote: it has entered into an agreement with Celestial AI to provide multi-laser integrated external light source (ELS) modules using its advanced packaging platform based on the POET Optical Interposer
The agreement includes a contract for continued platform development, along with a purchase order for initial quantities of the advanced modules

attributes.note: Feb 2022 agreement: POET to supply Celestial AI ELS/light-engine modules built on the POET Optical Interposer, with a development contract and a purchase order for initial quantities. See cancellation claim (April 2026) for termination.

claims.statement: On 2022-02-10 POET Technologies entered an agreement to supply Celestial AI with Optical Interposer-based multi-laser integrated external light source (ELS) modules, including a platform-development contract and a purchase order for initial quantities — establishing the POET→Celestial optical-engine supply channel (the indirect route by which Sivers, a POET laser supplier, reaches Celestial/Marvell demand).
claims.disproof_condition: Superseded if the POET→Celestial supply agreement is terminated or the parties disclose a replacement supplier (see the April 2026 Marvell cancellation).
